thread:
Maria: Heads-up — found inconsistent client-visible error payloads between hosted API and Dedicated for quota & routing failures. Console shows 'Quota exceeded' but API returns 429 with no hint field. We need a phrasebook + telemetry plan before rollout. Anyone own this?
Alex: I can take the mapping work. Quick Q: do we standardize on a top-level `error.kind` + `error.hint` or http-header hints?
Olivia: +1 on structured field. Headers are legacy; SDKs can't surface header hints consistently. Prefer JSON fields: `error.code`, `error.hint`, `error.route`.
Sam: Console also wants short human text for banners — 1-liner and optional link id. Example: "Quota exceeded for route 'chat-prod'. Learn more: /help/quotas#route"
Maria: Good — telemetry: need to tag metrics so we can split by cause (rate vs burst vs tenant-limit). Proposal: `client.error.count` with tags: `error_code`, `route`, `failmode`.
Alex: Agree. Also we should emit `x-client-retry-hint` header for clients that rely on headers; keep both for backward compat.
Olivia: Implementation nit: we must avoid PII in `error.hint`. So only codified hints: 'retry-after-seconds:30', 'try-smaller-batch', 'contact-sales'.
Sam: UX: when console sees `error.hint=try-smaller-batch` show inline tip with payload size slider. ok?
Maria: Yes. Also need sampling for rate-limited payloads to store examples in logs but not every token. Suggest 1/100 sampling + higher sample for tenant top offenders.
Alex: For rollout: feature flag `error-compact-v2` behind canary. Stages: dev SDKs, hosted API, dedicated default.
Olivia: Can we add metric `error.hint.surface.v2` to monitor adoption? Also track mismatch counts where SDK received header hint but no JSON hint.
deploybot: deploybot: Created PR #5123 -> add error.hint schema + telemetry tags. CI: tests pending.
Sam: Thanks. Next steps: Alex to PR mapping doc + example payloads; Maria to update console text variants; Olivia to wire metrics; I'll add banners for known hints.
Alex: I'll post a brief RFC link once PR is up. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Maria: thx all :thumbsup:
